home.heroEyebrow: Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church Sunday School
home.heroCopy: Simple Senbet is a school management system for Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Sunday Schools. Organize faith curriculum, liturgical attendance, student records, and parish contributions in one dependable place.
home.scripture: Train up a child in the way he should go; and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
home.pillarsIntro: A structured path for learning the faith and traditions of the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church, from childhood through youth service.

pillars.title: Scripture and Orthodox Teaching
pillars.description: Study the Old and New Testaments, the Orthodox Creed, the mysteries of faith, and the teachings of the Church Fathers.

pillars.title: The Hymns of Saint Yared
pillars.description: Learn the sacred Ethiopian chant tradition of Saint Yared, its notation, liturgical hymns, and ceremonial practice.

pillars.title: Liturgy and Church History
pillars.description: Explore the Holy Mysteries, Divine Liturgy, the Church calendar, fasting seasons, and Ethiopian Church history.

pillars.title: Christian Life and Service
pillars.description: Grow in charity, humility, fellowship, and practical service to the sick, elders, and parish community.

home.departmentsTitle: A workspace for every Sunday School role.
home.departmentsIntro: Give each parish department a clear place to carry out its responsibilities: academic planning, attendance, finance, and member coordination.

departments.title: Academics
departments.description: Manage academic years, curriculum, course plans, term schedules, and teaching assignments.

departments.title: Attendance
departments.description: Record participation in Divine Liturgy and Sunday School classes, and follow student attendance.

departments.title: Finance
departments.description: Record contributions, feast-day dues, book sales, receipts, and financial summaries.

departments.title: Members and families
departments.description: Maintain student and family records, parish contacts, and member groups with role-based access.

home.quote: Remember your leaders, who spoke the word of God to you. Consider the outcome of their way of life and imitate their faith.
commitments: Designed around the departments and responsibilities of EOTC Sunday Schools.
Role permissions keep academic, finance, teaching, and member records appropriately separated.
The interface supports English, Amharic, and Afaan Oromo.

values.title: Faith and sacred tradition
values.description: Nurture knowledge of Scripture, Orthodox teaching, and the hymns of Saint Yared.

values.title: Care for every learner
values.description: Help teachers and parish leaders support each student through reliable school records.

values.title: Service in community
values.description: Encourage fellowship, charity, and service within the parish community.
